description: This file defines the CustomerDao class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Time plugin, used for data access operations related to Customer entities. It includes methods for retrieving, searching, saving, deleting, and validating customers, as well as managing related projects and associated entities.

classes.name: CustomerDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Customer-related database operations in the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieve an active Customer entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieve existing customer IDs from a list of IDs that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Delete customers by their IDs, ensuring no associated timesheet items exist, and handle related projects.

methods.name: saveCustomer
methods.description: Persist a Customer entity to the database.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Search for customers based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getSearchCustomerPaginator
methods.description: Construct a paginator object for customer search with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: getSearchCustomersCount
methods.description: Get the count of customers matching search criteria.

methods.name: isCustomerNameTaken
methods.description: Check whether a customer name already exists (excluding a specific customer ID if provided).

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieve a customer by ID, regardless of deletion status.

methods.name: getCustomerIdList
methods.description: Get list of customer IDs, optionally including deleted customers.

methods.name: getCustomerIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Get customer IDs associated with a project administrator.

methods.name: hasCustomerGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Check if a customer currently has any timesheet items associated.

methods.name: getUnselectableCustomerIds
methods.description: Retrieve customer IDs that are linked with existing timesheet items and thus not selectable for certain operations.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectsForCustomer
methods.description: Delete all projects and related entities associated with specified customers.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Mark projects as deleted based on project IDs.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectActivitiesForProject
methods.description: Mark project activities as deleted for given project IDs.

methods.name: deleteRelativeProjectAdminsForProject
methods.description: Delete project admin records for specified projects.
